title: JSFL: timeline.getFrame(), doc.addItem(), doc.scaleContent stubs
description:
Add 3 small missing JSFL stubs to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
1. timeline.getFrame(layerIndex, frameIndex): JsflFrame - returns the JsflFrame proxy for the given layer/frame. Add to JsflTimeline interface and implementation. Look at how getFrameProperty() accesses frames to find the pattern.
2. doc.addItem(pos: {x: number, y: number}, item: {name?: string}): void - wraps library.addItemToDocument(item.name, pos.x, pos.y). Add to JsflDocument interface and proxy.
3. doc.scaleContent: boolean - read/write boolean property. Getter returns false (stub), setter is a no-op with console.warn. Add to JsflDocument interface and proxy.
